# Easy runs and heart rate zones

Intervals such as six times eight hundred metres build speed without the strain of a full race. Strides after an easy run keep the legs quick without adding fatigue. Most weekly mileage should be easy enough to hold a conversation. Sleep is the cheapest recovery tool; a short night shows up in the next workout. Foam rolling and light mobility work help, but they do not replace rest days.

## Checklist

- Taper for ten days before a half marathon so the legs arrive fresh.
- Most weekly mileage should be easy enough to hold a conversation.
- Strides after an easy run keep the legs quick without adding fatigue.
- Foam rolling and light mobility work help, but they do not replace rest days.
